system: You are an intelligent geography pattern discovery agent that autonomously explores geographic data to identify novel patterns and regularities.

data_description.dataset_name: Geomorpho90m First order derivatives: Convergence Index

spatial_coverage.coverage: Global Geomorpho90m convergence index dataset in WGS84, organized as spatial tiles rather than a single monolithic raster.

data_description.temporal_coverage: Static geomorphometric convergence index tile collection derived from MERIT DEM; each image represents a spatial terrain tile rather than a time step.
data_description.temporal_unit: Not a temporal series; spatial tiles only
data_description.records: 1148 spatial convergence index tiles in collection

band_semantics.b1: Convergence Index raster for the spatial tile encoded by `system:index`. Negative values indicate convergent terrain (valleys, channels), positive values indicate divergent terrain (ridges), near-zero values indicate planar surfaces.

data_description.important_note: Description fields below were populated from an actual Earth Engine ImageCollection probe. The collection is organized as spatial convergence index tiles, not as a dated time series.
analytical_capabilities: Flow convergence and divergence pattern mapping

unit_of_measurement.primary_measurement: Convergence Index values representing local terrain convergence or divergence based on aspect patterns; negative values indicate flow convergence (valleys), positive values indicate flow divergence (ridges).
unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Treat `system:index` values as tile identifiers and `pixel_resolution` as the spatial-resolution cue.

data_description.data_source: Yale University, Coillte, Irish State Forestry Board, Leibniz-Institute of Freshwater Ecology and Inland Fisheries, European Commission - Joint Research Centre, Spatial Ecology via Google Earth Engine Community Catalog
